title: Гладиатор в чужой спальне  (A Gladiator in the Wrong Bedroom)

segments.t: Dressed in a Roman gladiator helmet and cape, Barinov leaps onto the bed in suite 311—only to come face to face with Eleonora! Terrified that Elena in the adjoining room will hear them, Victor begs Eleonora to leave and tells Elena it was just a maid.
Кто здесь
заказывал сегодня
шефа в номер на всю...
Витя, черт.
Что здесь делаешь? Я? Я собираюсь спать.
А теперь собирайся и уходи отсюда.
Пожалуйста, умоляю тебя.
В этом номере другая женщина.
Я не хочу, чтобы она тебя видела. Витя, это ты?
Умоляю, не губи мою жизнь снова.
Завтра, завтра можешь меня уволить.
С кем ты тут разговаривал?
А горничная заходила, я ей сказал, что у тебя уже есть горничная.
Бред какой-то.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
Кто здесь
'Who in here' Over the conversation and the boss, Barinov answers Elena without a second thought.
заказывал сегодня
'ordered tonight' Around the conversation and boss, Barinov sets a calm, everyday tone with Elena.
шефа в номер на всю...
'the Chef to the room for the whole...' Between the conversation and the boss, Barinov gives Elena a quick, grounded response.
Витя, черт.
'Vitya, damn it!' Over the plan and the boss, Eleonora lets her real feelings show.
Что здесь делаешь? Я? Я собираюсь спать.

'What are you doing here? Me? I am getting ready to sleep.' With the plan and boss hanging in the air, Barinov puts Elena on the spot. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
А теперь собирайся и уходи отсюда.
'And now pack up and get out of here.' Telling Elena to pack up and get out of here is how Barinov lays out the situation for Elena.
Пожалуйста, умоляю тебя.
'Please, I beg you.' Begging Elena moves the conversation forward without extra drama. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
В этом номере другая женщина.
'There is another woman in this suite.' Mentioning that there is another woman in this suite moves the talk in a new direction.
Я не хочу, чтобы она тебя видела. Витя, это ты?
'I do not want her to see you. Vitya, is that you?' Questioning whether he does not want her to see Elena is how Barinov tests Elena's story.
Умоляю, не губи мою жизнь снова.
'I beg you, do not ruin my life again.' Because he begs Elena does not ruin his life again, Barinov treats the matter as settled.
Завтра, завтра можешь меня уволить.
'Tomorrow, you can fire me tomorrow.' Explaining that tomorrow Elena can fire him tomorrow lays the cards on the table for Elena.
С кем ты тут разговаривал?
'Who were you talking to in here?' By wondering who Barinov talking to in here was, Elena presses Barinov for a straight answer.
А горничная заходила, я ей сказал, что у тебя уже есть горничная.

'Oh, a maid came in, and I told her you already have a maid.' Claiming that a maid came in and he told her Elena already have a maid sounds confident, even if Elena has doubts. Russian expresses having something as "by me is", keeping the phrase short and grounded.
Бред какой-то.
'Some kind of nonsense.' Over the point and the boss, Elena answers Barinov without a second thought. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
